SANI-99™ for AGRI
Frequently Asked Questions.

01

Does Veterinary Grade SANI-99™ for AGRI meet International standards?

Yes. All tests are done in internationally accredited laboratories.​

Positive efficacy results have been achieved in laboratories in the UK, Scotland, Ireland, Singapore and South Africa.

02

Is Veterinary Grade SANI-99™ for AGRI approved by International institutions?

Yes. DEFRA, PCS and BEIC.

03

How many pathogens does Veterinary Grade SANI-99™ for AGRI kill?

A staggering sixty-eight highly infectious and disease-causing pathogens. These include enveloped viruses, Diseases of Origin, bacteria, protozoa, fungi and spores.

The most virulent and financially destructive diseases to animal farming, are killed by Veterinary Grade SANI-99™ for AGRI

04

Is Veterinary Grade SANI-99™ for AGRI safe for animals and humans?

Yes. Veterinary Grade SANI-99™ for AGRI is one of very few highly effective disinfectants which has been approved to be safe for animals and humans.

05

Can I use Veterinary Grade SANI-99™ for AGRI whilst my animals are still in its housing?

Yes. We promote that Veterinary Grade SANI-99™ for AGRI will be used whilst your animals are in their housing.

By breathing in Veterinary Grade SANI-99™ for AGRI through their nasal cavities, could prevent virus accumulation and disease outbreaks.

06

Is Veterinary Grade SANI-99™ for AGRI tested against the various strains of Avian Diseases?

Yes. Newcastle Disease and Avian Flu has no resistance to Veterinary Grade SANI-99™ for AGRI.

07

Can Veterinary Grade SANI-99™ for AGRI kill the Swine Flu Virus?

Yes. It has been approved by stringent DEFRA protocols as an effective product to prevent this disease.

08

Can Veterinary Grade SANI-99™ for AGRI kill the Foot and Mouth Virus?

Yes. Veterinary Grade SANI-99™ for AGRI has recently been tested by DEFRA, and it will successfully prevent any outbreaks.

 

09

What information do I need to know before using a disinfectant?

Is this disinfectant the right disinfectant for the suspected pathogen? ​ I have been using a trusted disinfectant for a long time, but I am experiencing financial losses due to mortalities. Why? ​ Did I ask the agent or manufacturer, proof of their laboratory results of claims made on their product label? ​ *Note: Many disinfectants claim to kill well-known pathogens, but these pathogens are resistant to the specific active ingredient in the disinfectant. ​ Do I apply the disinfectant according to protocol? ​ Quality versus Risk: Am I willing to pay more for a higher quality disinfectant, or will I take a risk with an inferior and cheaper product, which could lead to financial loss and animal deaths?

10

What makes Veterinary Grade SANI-99™ for AGRI different from other disinfects?

Even being highly effective, it is safe for animals and humans when inhaling or accidently consuming.

Inhaling Veterinary Grade SANI-99™ for AGRI could prevent the build-up of viruses and bacteria in the nasal cavities. This could eliminate or reduce infections and mortalities.

Studying our laboratory results, viruses and bacteria have not built resistance against our unique formulation, as to be found with the majority of ‘old and established’ brands.
